Speaking of quality — it’s consistently beautiful and flawless. The solid wood construction, the refined material finishes, and the curated fabric selections are all top notch. I’ve never had a single complaint about any of the pieces my clients have purchased from Tianu. The design language is timeless rather than trend-driven, which is exactly what we as a design firm look for. These statement pieces blend effortlessly into a variety of design styles we’ve executed over the years.

The team is another standout feature. Founder Vinita Kumar has always been warm, welcoming, and insightful. She often engages with clients personally, offering valuable inputs and helping shape a shared design vision. A special mention to Shruti Kadam, whose knowledge of the inventory, customization options, and fabric choices is exceptional — she makes the entire process smooth and stress-free.

The billing, checkout, and delivery process is handled with great efficiency. It’s the one place I always recommend — both to fellow designers in the fraternity and to my clients.

We recently got a complete bespoke U-shaped sofa designed, developed, and delivered by Furniturewalla (FW) Worli, Mumbai to our home in Pune – and I must share that this was one of the rarest pleasant experiences I’ve had in this industry.

Mr. Khalid: The true architect of our sofa – he patiently understood our needs, empathized with our lifestyle, and incorporated every detail into the design with precision.

Mr. Surendra & Mr. Imran: Surendra ensured smooth handling of design and delivery, while Imran travelled all the way from Mumbai to personally install the sofa. One massive section had to be carried up 20 floors as it couldn’t fit in the lift – and they got it done without a fuss!

What stood out most was the professionalism and human touch. I still remember FW calling us one late evening to confirm if we’d like to finalize the design. It was already 8 PM (their closing time), yet they encouraged us to visit, patiently waited till 11 PM, and helped us finalize every detail – from the layout to the fabric.

The result: a stunning U-shaped sofa that’s now the heart of our home.

Truly grateful for this unforgettable experience with FW Mumbai.
Highly recommend them to anyone looking for custom furniture with trust, quality, and genuine care.
